anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high (12.48, 13.92, 13.99) for an 8-core system, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
No active or closed trades, and all trading metrics (totalPL, winRate, roi) are zero, which is unusual for a trading platform.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating it might not be functioning as expected.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially adjust trading strategies to ensure they are functioning and generating trades.
Evaluate AI system configuration and ensure it is properly integrated and functioning to support trading decisions.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and address the root cause.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Assess the trading strategies and AI system to ensure they are active and correctly configured.
recommendations.rationale: Zero trading activity and AI inactivity suggest potential misconfigurations or system issues that need resolution to resume normal operations.

recommendations.action: Implement monitoring and alerting for key metrics such as CPU load, trading activity, and AI performance.
recommendations.rationale: Proactive monitoring will help detect and address issues before they impact system performance and trading outcomes.
